subject: Is it possible/easy to have button-like functionality in output tables?

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Is it possible/easy to have button-like functionality in output tables?
parts: What I want is to have is an output table where each row has a button beside it and clicking on the button would call an R function, with some parameters that depend on the row that is clicked. Is this possible?

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible/easy to have button-like functionality in output tables?
parts:
Just recently uploaded a table with selectable rows binding. Rows are clickable and the row number returns to R where you can call the function you need. If you absolutely need buttons, you can add a column of button tags to dataframe and tweak binding a little.
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/ZaYYmFLHA6U

messages.author: 762340260270eefa
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible/easy to have button-like functionality in output tables?
parts:
googleVis tables are also very easy to use for bindings.  Something simple like this will allow you to interact with them:

jscode <- "var sel = chart.getSelection();
      alert('You selected row' +  sel[0].row);"
    
gvisTable(dataframe,options=list(gvis.listener.jscode=jscode))
